verdict.rationale: No first-party benchmark data, latency figures, or recall metrics are present anywhere in the evidence pack—docs only describe features (vector/text/graph indexes, SDKs, CLI) without any performance numbers, and community threads (helixdb-comm-6, helixdb-comm-9) only show users asking unanswered questions about p99 latency and criticizing an apparently small, unverified 5M-record benchmark, which is not itself included as a citable vendor artifact in this pack. missing for 10: a vendor-published benchmark report or dataset with concrete latency/recall/throughput numbers, and any independent reproduction or corroboration of those numbers.
